extensions.linux_cloud_scope: mechanism-key+char-ngram-hash embedding; no neural sentence model

negative_controls.description: Exact rename, paraphrase, one-parameter fork, full rewrite must all be caught.
negative_controls.good_state_output: distinct seed vs unrelated text stays DISTINCT

negative_controls.description: Full rewrite must sit in low lexical band while embedding fires.
Hand-verified distinct set of >=24 units must yield zero MERGE pairs.

threshold_variance.note: fixed thresholds; hashed embedding is pure function of input text

report.gate: AND (MERGE requires both fires; single fire => CONTESTED)

retry.policy: Two strikes then pivot; if embedding thresholds fail twice, fall back to requiring human adjudication for the ambiguous band rather than tuning a third threshold.

reviewer.notes: PASS: fifth mutant class clause_order_permutation is caught (verdict=MERGE, lexical=1.0, embedding=0.99935). This class was not among the four calibration mutants (exact_rename, paraphrase, one_parameter_fork, full_rewrite). Order-only clause permutation stresses the set-Jaccard + hashed-key embedding AND gate without synonym dressing or parameter forks. Receipt left BLOCKED; did_not_promote=true.
